# Suvo

> Suvo is a supplement tracking app for cataloging a user's stack, reviewing supplement interaction and timing conflicts, and building a clearer supplement schedule.

Site: https://getsuvo.com/
Contact: hello@getsuvo.com
Language: en and de (German pages under /de/)

## Source policy

Suvo's supplement rules are educational and are not medical advice. Interaction, timing, and upper-limit guidance is based on named source tiers: regulatory authorities, government institutes, systematic reviews, academic references, and curated databases. The public source library explains why each source is trusted and where it fits in the hierarchy.
